shared_ancestry_note: Current FRANK/Clay/ClayCode/ClayGraph/GWT/Hyperposition/Emergenz/UnifiedDB material shares substantial RAE ancestry. Agreement is not counted as independent replication; external literature, NVIDIA hosted runtime and E2B execution only support the mechanisms they directly test.

clay.delta: Advance the integrated research frontier from COVE-G10 toward OPEN MOSAIC-G11. Keep COVE as the operation-specific causal slice; add explicit semantic, provenance-instance, basis/epoch, selection-plan and reader-view identity axes plus logical UnifiedDB planning and incremental derived-view receipts.
clay.next_experiment: Live/twin MOSAIC capsule replay under cross-store concurrent updates and reader-view mutations.

frank.delta: FRANK should consume UnifiedDB as a logical persistence/query substrate and MOSAIC capsules as operation-specific handoff identity. C6 View Compiler/MRSC gains separate semantic/contract/basis/selection/view identities; physical stores remain replaceable and capability/effect authority stays isolated.
frank.next_experiment: Implement one end-to-end read->Assembly->Workspace->MRSC->proposal->effect twin path with MOSAIC receipts and inject basis/plan/view mutations independently.

claycode.delta: Generalize E2B triple-bound identity into typed multi-axis identity. Add explicit collection algebra, query/selection-plan identity and basis identity to MRSC handoffs; semantic equality may support reuse but never replaces provenance or exact emitted-view binding.
claycode.next_experiment: E2B property/mutation tests over SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED semantics plus semantic/contract/basis/plan/view identity axes.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph becomes a specialized derived view inside UnifiedDB rather than the universal database. Relation/role semantics remain exact; graph epoch, activation epoch and derivation receipt are explicit. Query-aware activation may guide selection but never define truth/authority.
claygraph.next_experiment: Exact/FTS/vector/graph/activation route factorial with same canonical source and query-plan receipts; measure quality, latency, stale uptake and selection integrity.

unifieddb.delta: First Clay-foundry feedback to the new branch: start with semantic/logical unification and a cost-based physical polyglot planner. Preserve specialized exact, graph, vector, FTS, activation and capability stores until target measurements justify colocation. Derived views require source/derivation/epoch/rebuild receipts.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Run the dedicated UnifiedDB four-baseline benchmark: specialized, logical-federated, shared-canonical+sidecars, physical consolidation; include replay, p99, write amp, crash radius and query equivalence.

gwt.delta: Extend CSOC with MOSAIC capsule identity. GWT arms must pin or independently vary UnifiedDB basis/query-plan/selection identity and MRSC reader-view/rail identity; graph retrieval and workspace ignition remain distinct.
gwt.next_experiment: BASIS x QUERY_PLAN x WORKSPACE x RAIL/PROJECTION x REENTRY factorial with identical canonical semantic content.

emergenz.delta: E-CERT2 should bind every intervention to a MOSAIC capsule so role/semantic identity, provenance instance, basis, selector and reader representation are explicit. Database integration, protocol convergence or repeated views remain non-emergence evidence.
emergenz.next_experiment: Prospective lesion/rescue/OOD candidate with held-out macro discovery and capsule-matched intervention controls; compute PEID only after basis identity is pinned.

hyperposition.delta: H4 firebreaks gain an explicit identity-axis vector: semantic, instance/provenance, basis/epoch, selection-plan and view. Physical topology/storage can change without semantic identity change; compact hot-path handles may carry only operation-required witnesses.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Rust/C packed MOSAIC-handle benchmark plus cross-axis alias/staleness/plan mutation fuzz with fallback coverage measurements.
